$comment: The themes the goldens cover, read by tools/check_nui_snapshots.py (docs/ui/AUTHORING.md, Adding a theme). name is the short name in golden file names, id the theme id in assets/nui/nui/theme/themes.json; every theme there needs an entry here. A shipped theme is in every case whose themes are "all" (the full matrix). An experimental theme ("experimental": true) is only in the gallery and the pages its "pages" list names, at each of their scales.
